_comment: Era labels drawn on the timeline slider ('end' is exclusive; omit it for an open-ended era). Before 'annualFrom' the slider stops only at 'benchmarks'; each benchmark stands for the span up to the next one. coverageNotes are shown in the side panel.

coverageNotes.text: Benchmark years: figures are long-run estimates for the year shown, or the nearest year in its span, and events cover the whole span.
Sparse data before 1870. Estimates cover population, GDP per person and a few political series.
Pre-1960 data comes from historical research datasets and covers fewer territories.
